headline: GPT-5.6 Auto-Enabled as Subprocessor in Microsoft 365 Copilot
raw_snippet: OpenAI models including GPT-5.6 were auto-enabled as a subprocessor in Microsoft 365 Copilot on July 24, after being initially available as opt-in since July 9. GPT-5.6 is now the preferred model powering Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Chat and Cowork in Microsoft 365, delivering stronger performance per dollar for enterprise users. The move comes amid reports of a widening rift between OpenAI and Microsoft.
curator_notes: GPT-5.6 auto-enabled as default model in Microsoft 365 Copilot across Word, Excel, PowerPoint. Deepens the Microsoft relationship at a time of reported tensions. Key for IB given Microsoft's investment stake in OpenAI.
